# ghost_release (Data Source)

Looks up one release of a Ghost repository: the latest release, or a release by its ID or tag.

Drafts are only visible to people who can write to the repository, and are never the latest release.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The latest release: the most recently published release that is neither a
# draft nor a prerelease.
data "ghost_release" "latest" {
  repository  = "my-org/my-repo"
  retrieve_by = "latest"
}

# A release by its numeric ID.
data "ghost_release" "by_id" {
  repository  = "my-org/my-repo"
  retrieve_by = "id"
  release_id  = 42
}

# A release by its tag, drafts included.
data "ghost_release" "by_tag" {
  repository  = "my-org/my-repo"
  retrieve_by = "tag"
  release_tag = "v1.0.0"
}

output "latest_version" {
  value = data.ghost_release.latest.release_tag
}

output "download_urls" {
  value = [for a in data.ghost_release.by_tag.assets : a.browser_download_url]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `repository` (String) The repository's full name, `owner/slug`, e.g. `ghost_repository.example.full_name`. A repository's old name still works after a rename.
- `retrieve_by` (String) How to find the release:
  - `latest`: the most recently published release that is neither a draft nor a prerelease. Ghost orders by publication time, so a draft published today becomes the latest even if it was created before the current one.
  - `id`: the release with ID `release_id`.
  - `tag`: the release for tag `release_tag`, drafts included.

### Optional

- `release_id` (Number) The numeric release ID, e.g. `ghost_release.example.release_id`. Required when `retrieve_by` is `id`, and not allowed otherwise; set to the found release's ID.
- `release_tag` (String) The tag, without the `refs/tags/` prefix, e.g. `v1.0.0`. Tag names are case-sensitive. Required when `retrieve_by` is `tag`, and not allowed otherwise; set to the found release's tag.

### Read-Only

- `assets` (Attributes List) The files attached to the release, as Ghost lists them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--assets))
- `assets_url` (String) The API URL that lists the release's assets.
- `author_login` (String) The login of the user who created the release; null when their account has been deleted.
- `body` (String) The release notes, in Markdown; null when there are none.
- `commit_sha` (String) The commit the release's tag points at; null when the tag has been deleted. Ghost doesn't keep the branch a release was created from.
- `created_at` (String) When the release was created.
- `draft` (Boolean) Whether the release is an unpublished draft.
- `html_url` (String) The release's page in the web UI.
- `id` (String) The repository's current full name and the release ID, `owner/slug:release_id`, the same as a `ghost_release` resource's import ID. The repository part differs from `repository` when that names a repository that has since been renamed.
- `name` (String) The release title; null when it has none (the web UI then shows the tag name).
- `node_id` (String) The GraphQL node ID.
- `prerelease` (Boolean) Whether the release is marked as a prerelease.
- `published_at` (String) When the release was first published; null for a draft that has never been published.
- `repository_id` (Number) The numeric ID of `repository`.
- `tarball_url` (String) The API URL of the tag's source tarball.
- `upload_url` (String) The URI template for uploading assets, taking `name` and `label`.
- `url` (String) The release's API URL.
- `zipball_url` (String) The API URL of the tag's source zip archive.

<a id="nestedatt--assets"></a>
### Nested Schema for `assets`

Read-Only:

- `browser_download_url` (String) The URL that downloads the file in a browser.
- `content_type` (String) The file's media type, e.g. `application/zip`.
- `created_at` (String) When the asset was uploaded.
- `download_count` (Number) How many times the file has been downloaded.
- `id` (Number) The numeric asset ID.
- `label` (String) The label shown instead of the file name; null when it has none.
- `name` (String) The file name.
- `node_id` (String) The GraphQL node ID.
- `size` (Number) The file size in bytes.
- `updated_at` (String) When the asset was last changed.
- `url` (String) The asset's API URL.
